meta.name: linkedin-content
meta.description: LinkedIn post writing with hook formulas, formatting rules, and engagement patterns. Covers post types, algorithm signals, character limits, and content pillars. Use for: LinkedIn posts, professional content, thought leadership, B2B content, personal branding. Triggers: linkedin post, linkedin content, linkedin writing, linkedin strategy, linkedin engagement, linkedin algorithm, linkedin hook, linkedin formatting, thought leadership, professional content, b2b content, linkedin growth

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出高互动 LinkedIn 帖子，提升个人品牌影响力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要持续产出专业且有吸引力的 LinkedIn 内容
copy.tagline_en: Write high-engagement LinkedIn posts to boost your personal brand
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to consistently produce professional and engaging LinkedIn content

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你写高互动的 LinkedIn 帖子，包括设计钩子、格式化正文、选择内容支柱和行动号召，并给出算法优化建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“LinkedIn 帖子”、“LinkedIn 内容”、“LinkedIn 写作”等关键词，或要求写专业内容、B2B 内容、个人品牌时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一条关于远程团队管理的 LinkedIn 帖子，用个人故事开头。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含钩子、正文和 CTA 的完整帖子。

say.text: 给我 3 个适合 B2B 内容的 LinkedIn 钩子公式。
say.note: Claude 会列出钩子公式并附示例。

say.text: 分析这条 LinkedIn 帖子草稿，指出改进点。
say.note: Claude 会检查钩子、格式、CTA 等。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you write high-engagement LinkedIn posts, including designing hooks, formatting body text, choosing content pillars and CTAs, and providing algorithm optimization tips.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "LinkedIn post", "LinkedIn content", "LinkedIn writing", or ask for professional content, B2B content, personal branding.

say_en.text: Write a LinkedIn post about remote team management, starting with a personal story.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a full post with hook, body, and CTA.

say_en.text: Give me 3 hook formulas for B2B LinkedIn content.
say_en.note: Claude will list hook formulas with examples.

say_en.text: Analyze this LinkedIn post draft and suggest improvements.
say_en.note: Claude will check hook, formatting, CTA, etc.
